concerns.location: tasks.md:T008 vs spec.md:FR-006, US-2 scenario 1, US-3 scenario 1
concerns.text: T008 replaces the Diebold–Mariano test with a Spatial Block Permutation Test and tags it '[FR-006/FR-009]'. FR-006 is a MUST for a DM test on prediction errors; the spec was never amended. Also US-2 scenario 1's specific criterion (model beats naive baseline, DM p < 0.05) has no implementing task — T008 only includes combined-vs-naive as one of three Bonferroni-adjusted comparisons. Either amend FR-006/SC-002 in the spec or add the DM test alongside the spatial correction.

FR-008 MUSTs the effort covariate 'as an additional predictor' in the model; T004 states 'effort used ONLY for threshold adjustment, never as a model predictor — FR-003, FR-008'. This is a semantic weakening of a MUST-level FR made unilaterally in plan/tasks without a spec amendment. Amend FR-008 or justify the deviation in the spec itself.

FR-007 and SC-006 require continental-scale maps; T010 produces only regional Pacific Northwest maps. The scope narrowing is a plan-level decision never reflected in the spec. Amend FR-007/SC-006 to 'regional' or the task under-delivers its claimed FR.

FR-011 has two conjunctive MUSTs: validate MODIS covariates against in-situ weather station records (e.g., NOAA GHCN) AND require ≥95% coverage. T003 implements only the coverage check; no task performs any GHCN/in-situ comparison. Half of FR-011 is silently dropped.

T009 requires 'importance_stability' in metrics.json, but metrics.schema.yaml has no metric_type or field for it and sets additionalProperties: false — the promised artifact cannot conform to the contract T009 is required to validate against. Same issue for SC-005's ranking-consistency check in T007 (only vaguely 'recorded in metrics.json').

FR-010 MUSTs a spatial random-effects term 'in the XGBoost model'; T006 fits a post-hoc GP added to XGBoost outputs. Defensible reinterpretation, but it should be recorded as a spec amendment, not only in plan rationale.
